Salary & compliance

Compliance rules last verified: 13 October 2026 · View current Gujarat notification ↗

Each setting applies from its start month until the next saved setting. Earlier months keep their previous settings. Saving the same start month replaces that version.

Monthly salary breakup

Percentages use fixed monthly salary. Special allowance receives the balance. Variable pay and payroll adjustments stay separate. The law does not prescribe one universal Basic/HRA percentage split.

Set any monthly amount for this employee, then save it from the selected start month. Company-provided accommodation is included in CTC; CTC less accommodation and employer costs gives cash salary. Salary breakup uses cash salary.

This confirmed statutory exemption affects automatic PF and ESIC coverage.

Auto checks PF entry wages up to ₹25,000; declared existing members continue above the entry ceiling. The statutory wage estimate includes Basic, DA, medical and special allowances, regular variable earnings and the 50% add-back including employer PF and accommodation. You can choose Basic + DA only or a confirmed manual base. If the statutory wage definition requires other allowances or an add-back, choose Manual wage override. The base is prorated for unpaid days, then capped; each contribution rounds to the nearest rupee. Employer PF / EPS is shown separately from take-home pay. The current wage ceiling is ₹25,000 from 17 September 2026; that transition month needs a verified base and cap.

Auto checks the ₹21,000 ESIC entry ceiling (₹25,000 for the confirmed disability category), retains recorded coverage through April–September or October–March, and exempts the employee share when average daily contribution wages are up to ₹176. The default wage base uses the statutory estimate; cash earnings and manual-base options remain available. Review the earnings classification and choose Manual wage override when the statutory wage base differs; a manual monthly base is prorated for unpaid days. Standard rates are 0.75% employee and 3.25% employer, each rounded up to a whole rupee. Confirm coverage and contribution-period continuation before enabling; salary above the coverage ceiling does not automatically end existing coverage.

Gujarat: ₹0 up to ₹12,000; ₹200 above ₹12,000, on earned regular salary, variable pay and incentive, excluding bonus and reimbursement. For exemptions or other states, enter the applicable manual amount. A manual amount is used as entered, without day proration. Under the Gujarat preset, an employee leaving before month-end has the tax reduced in proportion to their last working day.

Government references & calculation scope

Enable contributions when legally applicable to the establishment and employee. Turning a control off in this app does not make a statutory obligation optional. Verify statutory wage bases and applicable exemptions. This editor calculates payroll amounts; it does not file returns or calculate TDS, gratuity, EDLI, PF administration charges or the employer EPS allocation.
